blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marcos administration plans to raise at least P30 billion from its first retail treasury bonds (RTBs) issuance aimed at small investors this year, with the public offering set to start next week. In a notice of offering posted on Wednesday, the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) said it will issue 2.5-year peso-denominated RTBs due Apr. 12, 2029. READ: Philippine Treasury scales back upcoming retail T-bond sale In addition, investors will have the opportunity to purchase the bonds from Sept. 29 to Oct. 7, and the issue date will be on Oct. 12.
